messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — Elevated p50/p95 latency observed for /v1/generate across us-west-2 starting ~1930001100. Error rate remains low but tail latency spiked. Paging oncall: @sam (oncall) @priya (sre)

sam (oncall): saw it. I'm on it. grabbing logs now.

priya (sre): thanks. initial look — a subset of requests are hitting a slow KV cache path. p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~1.2s. No 5xx surge.

jordan (runtime): tagging in — might be an autoscaler / queueing interop with batching. Did we just roll anything?

sam (oncall): no prod deploys in last 30m according to deploy-bot. ops-bot: no recent infra changes.

ops-bot: Deploys: none in last 60m. Autoscaler events: spike in queue depth at 1930001050, scaled 2->3 after 40s.

jordan (runtime): can you dump slow stacks?

sam (oncall): posting snippet: ```
2026-03-xxT12:45:22Z GET /v1/generate latency=1280ms backend=kv-cache shard=us-west-2-3
2026-03-xxT12:45:23Z GET /v1/generate latency=1175ms backend=kv-cache shard=us-west-2-3
```

priya (sre): consistent with KV cache miss storm + hot shard. mitigation idea: route new short-lived traffic to model-variant-bypassed cache (fallthrough) and enable aggressive prefix caching.

jordan (runtime): we can flip routing to fallback pool that bypasses kv-cache for 10m. That will increase cost slightly but should restore p95. I can do the route change.

sam (oncall): do it. also notify support to pause any customer migrations.

jordan (runtime): routing change done at 1930001250 — small test traffic looks back to ~140ms p95.

emily (support): noted. Customer-facing status page updated: "Investigating latency in us-west-2 for text generation; mitigation in progress."

mike (product): any customers impacted? metrics?

priya (sre): preliminary customer impact: ~0.8% of requests in the window had >1s latency, mostly non-critical background jobs. 3 paying customers reported elevated latency via support; no billing anomalies.

sam (oncall): Live mitigation successful; keeping fallback route for now. Still want root cause and revert checklist before full rollback.

jordan (runtime): agreed. I captured traces and started a targeted KV shard reshard job to rebalance hot keys.

sam (oncall): next steps — schedule post-incident review, assign remediation actions, and do a brown-bag shareout. Who can own postmortem writeup?

priya (sre): I'll kick off the postmortem and own the timeline. Suggest draft due in 3 business days, final in 7. I'll coordinate with runtime and product.

jordan (runtime): I'll provide logs, tracing, and the reshard plan. Owner for remediation: me for reshard and config guardrails.

emily (support): I'll assemble the customer impact timeline and copies of support tickets; will be added to the postmortem.

sam (oncall): action items captured below. putting owners and ETA inline: 
- priya (sre): postmortem doc (draft by 1930250000, final by 1930500000) :memo:
- jordan (runtime): full reshard and heatmap of hot keys, plus config to limit single-shard heat (eta 2d) :wrench:
- emily (support): customer impact timeline + comms follow-up (eta 1d) :email:
- sam (oncall): rollback playbook and canary test to safely revert fallback routing (eta 3d) :white_check_mark:

priya (sre): adding remediation: add alert when single-shard p95 > 3x baseline for >2m. I'll file infra ticket.

sam (oncall): filing follow-up JIRA: INF-4823 with above owners.

ops-bot: JIRA INF-4823 created by sam (oncall) — https://jira.internal/INF-4823

mike (product): can we turn this incident into a short internal training? maybe 30min brownbag on "hot-shard detection and safe fallbacks". good ops->product story.

priya (sre): +1. propose next Thu 10:30am PT. I'll do a 20m walkthrough, jordan can demo the reshard steps. emily can cover customer comms.

sam (oncall): schedule tentative: Thu 1930600000 10:30am PT. invite: eng, eng-sre, product, support.

jordan (runtime): I'll prepare a short demo repo + safe commands. include `--dry-run` in docs.

emily (support): I'll send a short post-incident note to affected customers tomorrow with summary and next steps.

priya (sre): postmortem owners and outline: 
- Summary & timeline (who/what/impact)
- Root cause analysis (KV hot shard due to prefix distribution)
- Detection & monitoring gaps (alert missing)
- Mitigation steps (fallback routing decision and reshard)
- Remediation plan (shard guardrail, alerts, runbook updates)
- Customer impact & comms
- Action items & owners

sam (oncall): good. I'll mark this thread as handoff-complete when postmortem draft is uploaded. For now, lowering page severity to SILENT since mitigation is in place but monitors active.

incident-bot: Pager severity updated to SILENT at 1930001950 by sam (oncall).

priya (sre): small follow-up: add a test to our nightly canary that simulates hot key distribution to validate reshard automation. assigning to runtime infra.

jordan (runtime): noted, filing a PR to add the simulation harness.

sam (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the postmortem thread when draft ready. :wave:
